rollback.ordering: The first header-slot call is the gathered data barrier before restoration or wipe. The second proves C2J CLEAR after every restoration write.

persistent_publish.ordering: The persistent append completes decode, then scans, resolves, commits its header, and only then publishes exports. Current slot 39 is mandatory, not an optional range member.

representation.kind: three named zero-terminated uint8 arrays consumed by one named and sized non-LTO assembler leaf in the resident Island
representation.selection: the C caller passes the canonical linked array pointer in __rc2/__rc3 and context in __rc4/__rc5; no transport id or selector table rebuilds plan identity
representation.rule: c2_append_plan_walk invokes the one generic Session seam once per nonzero data byte. The walker owns no status, rollback, or publication policy.

phase_plans.range_rule: A numeric range is permitted only for an ascending, semantically contiguous phase sequence; descending and semantic-gap requests fail closed.
phase_plans.overlay_rule: The resident serial driver is the sole caller; no overlay calls another overlay.

publish_clear_co_residence.request_storage: record byte 23, after the roots/fronts marker lifetime has ended
publish_clear_co_residence.ordering: the resident serial driver writes one request marker and calls the sole physical record; the dispatcher clears the marker before either body mutates state
publish_clear_co_residence.failure: missing, foreign, skipped or replayed markers fail before either logical body changes state
publish_clear_co_residence.overlay_rule: the named and sized assembler selector and both C bodies share one section; the selector tail-jumps to exactly one body and none calls another overlay

selector.abi: c2_append_state pointer in __rc2/__rc3; uint8 result in A

journal_prepare_co_residence.request_storage: existing record byte 31 C2J result: NONE, PREPARED, ACTIVE
journal_prepare_co_residence.ordering: normal append with a main-ordinal sink writes directly; rollback without a sink advances NONE to PREPARED to ACTIVE through two serial calls
journal_prepare_co_residence.failure: missing preparation, foreign result, skipped call, or replay after ACTIVE fails before either logical body mutates state
journal_prepare_co_residence.selector_totality: For each main-ordinal class all 256 marker bytes have a defined result: only NONE for a normal append and NONE/PREPARED for rollback are accepted; the other 509 combinations return C2_STREAM_ERR_STATE.
journal_prepare_co_residence.tail_abi: Both selector tail edges restore the llvm-mos C-entry invariant Z=0 after reading record[31]; a tail edge with any other last Z definition is a build error.
journal_prepare_co_residence.overlay_rule: the dispatcher and both bodies share one section and none calls another overlay

C2J_bookend_seal.algorithm: CRC16/CCITT-FALSE via the existing rtov_crc_mem assembler leaf
C2J_bookend_seal.coverage: all 64 final C2J bytes including the record-owned CRC32 in bytes 60..63
C2J_bookend_seal.producer_order: finish fields -> finish format CRC32 -> bind seal -> submit ACTIVE
C2J_bookend_seal.recovery_order: validate format CRC32, identity and ranges -> bind seal from the validated snapshot -> reconstruct -> rollback
C2J_bookend_seal.consumer: the common header-phase completion body compares one independently read target CRC with the bound seal
C2J_bookend_seal.lifetime_proof: source-record interpretation has ended before journal_write owns the bytes; no phase marker, fused selector, code-base tuple or journal-result byte aliases 25..26; CLEAR proof releases them
C2J_bookend_seal.forbidden: field-by-field reconstruction in the completion poll

badopcode_detail_retirement.reason: the internal BADOPCODE detail was diagnostic scaffolding for the now corrected and permanently cutpoint-covered phase plans
preserved: cold tagged install-phase provenance outside the append work structs
badopcode_detail_retirement.rule: Fixtures prevent raw plan-latch regressions. The later install-phase discriminator reserves only the scratch tail and does not restore slot capture, result detail, renderer dispatch or BCODE materialization.
